title: Make the poller wait its turn, survive errors and stop cleanly
acceptanceCriteria: The first poll runs immediately, not after `intervalMs`
The next poll starts `intervalMs` after the previous one **finishes**, so two polls never run at once
A failed poll is passed to `onError`, and polling carries on
`stop()` during an in-flight poll means no further poll ever starts
`stop()` between polls cancels the scheduled one
